{"metadata":{"description":"In-session question minimap for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a vertical column of round dots overlaid on the left edge of the conversation column, one dot per user question — hover enlarges and shows full text, click jumps to that message.","id":"gh:1341946801","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-question-nav","slug":"AbelKeithsun/dsh-question-nav","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"In-session question minimap for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a vertical column of round dots overla"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"id on the left edge of the conversation column, one dot per user question — hover enlarges and shows"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" full text, click jumps to that message."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-question-nav"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English |
简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"In-session question navigator for the [DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI][dsh]: a
vertical column of sm"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"all round dots overlaid on the **left edge** of the
conversation column — one dot per user question."},{"id":"p4s3","text":" Hover a dot to magnify it
(together with its two neighbors on each side) and reveal a vertical casc"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ade
of crisp question cards with each question's **full text** and **sent time**
(clicking any card "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"jumps to it); click a dot to scroll the chat to that
question."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It is an external plugin bundle with zero runtime dependencies — the browser
half (`lib/client.js`) "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"externalizes everything to the DSH shell, so it adds
only a small bundle to the GUI at load time."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Package: **`@luziyang2026/dsh-question-nav`** ([npm][npm] · [GitHub][github])."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Plugin settings (rail alignment + dots per page):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Left-edge dot minimap** (embedded, not reserving any width). The rail's
anchor edge is configura"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ble — **Settings → Plugins → Question Nav → Rail
alignment** switches it between the left and right "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"edge of the conversation
column.
- **Height-capped and scrollable**: the dot column is vertically ce"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ntered and
uses at most **60%** of the conversation height; longer sessions scroll
inside that band "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"(wheel over the dots or the gaps between them).
- **One dot = one turn that asked a question** (stri"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ctly aligned with the
Trajectory view's turn numbering), with a small count above the dot column.
- "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"**Full history, persisted, no render-window expansion**: the plugin's host
half registers a `questio"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"nIndex` session projection — the projection
registry folds the whole event log (read-only, the chat'"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"s paged window is
never touched), the official projection cache persists it across restarts,
and pus"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"h frames deliver new questions live.
- **Hover (focus)**: the dot and its **two neighbors on each si"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"de** magnify
progressively (selected largest), the rail scrolls the selection into view
only when cl"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ipped by the band's edges, and a
**vertical cascade of five crisp question cards** (portal-rendered,"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" no
native-title delay) appears beside the rail — one card per window dot,
stacked top-to-bottom wit"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"hout overlap and centered on the selected dot. Each
card shows the turn's **full question text** (al"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"l of them, when one turn
batched several) and the question's **sent time** (`HH:MM` on the same day,"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"
`MM-DD HH:MM` across days, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` across years). The hierarchy
is two-tier: the **cente"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"r card is the focus** — full-contrast text, a brand
accent bar and a raised shadow — while the four "},{"id":"p10s18","text":"neighbors are clean
**context cards** (same surface, narrower, fewer lines) that light up on
hover t"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"o show they are clickable too. **Clicking any card jumps to that
question** exactly like clicking it"},{"id":"p10s20","text":"s dot.
- **Click**: jumps to that question. Only then does the jump loop page the
window (`loadOlder"},{"id":"p10s21","text":"()`) to bring that specific page into view — never the
whole history up front.
- **Paged overflow**:"},{"id":"p10s22","text":" when many dots don't fit the 60% band, the native
scrollbar is hidden and two small triangle button"},{"id":"p10s23","text":"s in the dot style appear —
**▲ above the dot queue and ▼ below it** — each click revealing the next"},{"id":"p10s24","text":"
page of hidden dots, which pop in with a short staggered animation as click
feedback. The page size"},{"id":"p10s25","text":" is configurable — **Settings → Plugins → Question
Nav → Dots per page** (3 / 5 / 8 / 10, default 5)"},{"id":"p10s26","text":". The triangles themselves
are the overflow cue — each appears only while its direction has more dot"},{"id":"p10s27","text":"s
to reveal (wheel and trackpad still scroll too); **hovering never scrolls
the band**, so the dots "},{"id":"p10s28","text":"stay put while you browse.
- Empty/left areas of the rail pass pointer events through to the convers"},{"id":"p10s29","text":"ation
(it never blocks the chat)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (a runnable DSH profile; the `dsh` CLI).
- Node.js `>= 20` (matches the D"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Web GUI (a runnable DSH profile; the `dsh` CLI).
- Node.js `>= 20` (matches the DSH SDK peer range)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Which version to install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The package publishes **two lines** under the same name, so pick the one that
matches the DSH build "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"shes **two lines** under the same name, so pick the one that
matches the DSH build your GUI runs on:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| npm dist-tag | Version | Targets the DSH | Status |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `latest` | `0.7.x` | `0.1.1-rc.1` SDK line | **Stable** — recommended for everyday use |
| `alpha`"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" | `0.8.0-alpha.x` | `0.1.2-alpha.2` SDK line | **Alpha** — for the Alpha GUI build |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Most users install the `latest` (stable) line** — it tracks the stable DSH
release and is safe f"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"or daily use.
- **Running the DSH Alpha GUI (`0.1.2-alpha.2`)?** Install the `alpha`
dist-tag instea"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"d. The stable build reads a chat snapshot API
(`session.getSnapshot().chat`) that was **removed** in"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" the Alpha SDK; the
`alpha` build reads the live chat through the new conversation service
instead. "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"Installing the stable line on an Alpha GUI would leave the strip
degraded (projection-only dots).
- "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"**Not sure which DSH build you have?** Check the version in your GUI / with
`dsh --version`; if it r"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"eports `0.1.1-rc.x`, use `latest`; if it reports
`0.1.2-alpha.x`, use `alpha`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Install the prebuilt package from npm and add it to a profile. **Use the
dist-tag that matches your "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"DSH build** (see above):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Stable line (DSH `0.1.1-rc.1`, most users):**"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Alpha line (DSH `0.1.2-alpha.2` GUI):**"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"If you prefer a specific version, pin it explicitly:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Then restart the DSH Web GUI to load the new bundle."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Build from source / develop locally"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"This repository is a standalone plugin project — build it, then add the
checkout to a profile as an "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"installable [bundle][bundle]:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## How it is built"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The client half uses the shared DSH client-bundle preset
(`tsdown.client.ts`, vendored into this rep"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"o), which emits
a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` closure-factory
artifact with CSS "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"Modules inlined and externals resolved through the loader
module table."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"MIT."}],"truncated":false}
